metadata.title: Intrinsic Rigidity of Bar-and-Joint Frameworks on Riemannian Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We develop an intrinsic rigidity theory for bar-and-joint frameworks whose vertices are constrained to a Riemannian manifold and whose edges are given by minimizing geodesic arcs. Such frameworks are called rigid if they cannot be deformed beyond the ambient isometries, while preserving the geodesic edge lengths. For admissible placements, for which adjacent vertices are joined by unique minimizing geodesics, we define a coordinate-free rigidity operator as the differential of the squared geodesic distance of the edges. By the first-variation formula, its edge rows are expressed in terms of the Riemannian logarithm, providing an intrinsic analogue of the classical Euclidean rigidity matrix. Trivial motions are characterized by orbits of the diagonal action of the isometry group, leading to notions of infinitesimal and local rigidity. We further develop a covariant second-order rigidity theory using the Riemannian Hessians of the edge constraints and characterize second-order rigidity through self-stresses and associated quadratic forms. Finally, we show that infinitesimal and second-order rigidity can be used as sufficient conditions for the local rigidity of an intrinsic framework. Our overarching goal is to provide a unified differential-geometric formulation of intrinsic framework rigidity on smooth manifolds.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 流形上杆铰框架的内蕴刚性
analysis.workSummary: 为黎曼流形中以最短测地线为边的杆铰框架建立无坐标刚性算子和协变二阶理论。用等距群轨道描述平凡运动，并以自应力和二次型给出二阶刚性刻画及局部刚性的充分条件。
techniques: 测地距离平方的一阶变分
analysis.breakthrough: 把欧氏刚性矩阵及二阶刚性条件推广为统一的内蕴几何框架。
analysis.limitations: 相邻顶点须由唯一最短测地线连接；无穷小和二阶刚性提供局部刚性的充分条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 把刚性问题直接转化为黎曼微分几何
